title: Make review_pack budget gaps actionable
outcome: When review_pack is incomplete, an agent can see which bounded subset of paths was omitted and choose a precise recovery action.
acceptance: A separately bounded list names affected paths without allowing the disclosure itself to exceed response budgets.
Budget-limited responses include total affected paths, returned paths, truncation state, and a stable reason identifier.
Coverage and retry guidance remain honest when the affected-path list is truncated.
The capability is represented by its own features[] identifier and BuildInfo.Version is bumped.
